prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is close, take it and check its properties. If not, approach or move. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    />      <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />  <Action ID = Move    />  <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />  <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
